grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Comparisons with as . . . as
grammarPoints.rule: Use as + adjective + as to say two things are the same in some way. Use not as + adjective + as to say two things are different. You can use one instead of repeating a noun.
grammarPoints.pattern: subject + is/are + as + adjective + as + noun. subject + is/are + not as + adjective + as + noun.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Tag questions
grammarPoints.rule: Add a short tag question to the end of a statement to check that it is true. Use a negative tag after a positive statement, and a positive tag after a negative statement. The tag's pronoun matches the subject, and its verb form matches the statement's verb (be, or a form of do for action verbs).
grammarPoints.pattern: positive statement + negative tag? / negative statement + positive tag?

tab4_master.jp: あのカエルは毒がありませんでしたよね？

tab4_master.cue: Build the tag question: cute / are / penguins / so / baby / they / aren't
tab4_master.jp: 赤ちゃんペンギンはとてもかわいいですよね？

stem: Which tag question correctly follows 'Cats like sleeping in the sun'?

explanation.title: action verb + do tag
explanation.body: 'Like' needs the tag 'don't they', a form of 'do'.

tab4_master.jp: 猫は日向で眠るのが好きですよね？

tab4_master.cue: Build the tag question: donkey / thirsty / doesn't / look / the / it / doesn't
tab4_master.jp: そのロバはのどが渇いているようには見えませんよね？

stem: Which tag question is correct after 'Those weren't copycat animals'?

explanation.title: negative + positive tag
explanation.body: A negative statement with 'weren't' takes the positive tag 'were they?'.

tab4_master.jp: あれらはまね動物ではありませんでしたよね？

japanese.title: 付加疑問文
japanese.rule: 文が本当かどうか確認するために、文の最後に短いタグクエスチョンを付け加えます。肯定文のあとには否定のタグを、否定文のあとには肯定のタグを使います。タグの代名詞は主語に合わせ、動詞の形は文の動詞（be、または動作動詞なら do の形）に合わせます。
japanese.pattern: 肯定文 + 否定のタグ？ / 否定文 + 肯定のタグ？
